result.content:
1. # Local Ignition 8.3 Development Setup
2. 
3. This guide covers setting up a reproducible Ignition development environment on any system.
4. 
5. ## Prerequisites
6. 
7. - **Docker** and **Docker Compose** installed
8. - **Git** (to clone the repository)
9. - **Python 3.8+** (for optional local scripts)
10. - **Disk space**: ~5 GB for Ignition data directory
11. 
12. ## Quickstart (5 minutes)
13. 
14. ### 1. Clone the Repository
15. ```bash
16. git clone https://github.com/NXEdge/SHD-Ignition-BOI1.git
17. cd SHD-Ignition-BOI1
18. ```
19. 
20. ### 2. Start the Ignition Container
21. ```bash
22. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
23. ```
24. 
25. The container will:
26. - Initialize the Ignition 8.3.8 data directory (first run only)
27. - Mount all project folders from this repo into the gateway
28. - Start on `http://localhost:8088` (HTTP) and `https://localhost:8043` (HTTPS)
29. 
30. ### 3. Verify It's Running
31. ```bash
32. # Wait for the gateway to initialize (~30-60 seconds)
33. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f ignition
34. 
35. # Once you see "Ignition gateway running...", press Ctrl+C
36. ```
37. 
38. ### 4. Access the Gateway
39. - **Gateway Admin Console**: `https://localhost:8043/admin` (ignore self-signed cert warning)
40. - **Perspective**: `https://localhost:8043/web/NxSigma_Testbed/` (recommended for UI testing)
41. - **Default credentials**: `admin` / `localdev123!`
42. 
43. ---
44. 
45. ## File Organization
46. 
47. ### Docker & Environment
48. 
49. | File | Purpose | Tracked? |
50. |------|---------|----------|
51. | `docker-compose.local.yml` | Container orchestration (Ignition 8.3.8) | ✅ Yes |
52. | `.config/ignition/gateway.env` | Local API tokens and URLs for scripting | ✅ Yes |
53. | `.ignition-local/` | Runtime Ignition data (generated) | ❌ No |
54. | `.env` | System-specific overrides (if needed) | ❌ No |
55. 
56. ### Ignition Projects
57. 
58. All projects are mounted as live volumes into the container. Changes to JSON/Python files **auto-reload** in the gateway (for most resources).
59. 
60. ```
61. NxSigma_Core/                  Parent project (shared resources)
62. ├── com.inductiveautomation.perspective/
63. │   ├── style-classes/         NxEdge design tokens
64. │   ├── stylesheet/            Global CSS
65. │   ├── views/                 Embedded utility views
66. │   └── page-config/           Shared page routing
67. └── ignition/
68.     ├── script-python/         Shared gateway scripts
69.     ├── named-query/           SQL templates
70.     └── global-props/          Shared project properties
71. 
72. NxSigma_Engine/                Logic layer (timers, startup scripts)
73. NxSigma_LineMaster/            Perspective UI & page configs
74. NxSigma_MaterialsManager/       Materials domain logic
75. NxSigma_Testbed/               Development & testing
76. ```
77. 
78. ---
79. 
80. ## Common Tasks
81. 
82. ### Start/Stop the Gateway
83. ```bash
84. # Start
85. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
86. 
87. # Stop
88. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml down
89. 
90. # View logs
91. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f ignition
92. 
93. # Restart (useful after major code changes)
94. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml restart ignition
95. ```
96. 
97. ### Access the Designer
98. 
99. 1. Download **Ignition Designer 8.3.8** from [inductiveautomation.com](https://www.inductiveautomation.com/downloads)
100. 2. Launch the Designer
101. 3. **File** → **Connect** → Enter:
102.    - **Gateway host**: `localhost:8088`
103.    - **Username**: `admin`
104.    - **Password**: `localdev123!`
105. 
106. ### View Gateway Logs
107. ```bash
108. # Real-time logs
109. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f ignition
110. 
111. # Last 100 lines
112. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs --tail 100 ignition
113. ```
114. 
115. ### Reset to Fresh State
116. ```bash
117. # Stop the container
118. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml down
119. 
120. # Remove the cached data directory
121. rm -rf .ignition-local/data
122. 
123. # Start fresh
124. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
125. ```
126. 
127. ### Test Local API Integration
128. 
129. The gateway exposes a local API for scripting:
130. 
131. ```bash
132. # Load credentials
133. source .config/ignition/gateway.env
134. 
135. # Test API connectivity
136. curl -k -sS -H "Accept: application/json" \
137.   -H "X-Ignition-API-Token: ${X-Ignition-API-Token}" \
138.   https://localhost:8043/data/api/v1/ping
139. 
140. # Scan project changes (after editing views/scripts)
141. curl -k -sS -X POST \
142.   -H "Accept: application/json" \
143.   -H "X-Ignition-API-Token: ${X-Ignition-API-Token}" \
144.   https://localhost:8043/data/api/v1/scan/projects
145. ```
146. 
147. ---
148. 
149. ## Customization
150. 
151. ### Change Admin Password
152. Edit `docker-compose.local.yml` and modify the `GATEWAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD` environment variable, then restart:
153. ```bash
154. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml restart ignition
155. ```
156. 
157. ### Change Port Mappings
158. Edit `docker-compose.local.yml` and update the `ports:` section:
159. ```yaml
160. ports:
161.   - "8088:8088"   # Change first number to expose on a different host port
162.   - "8043:8043"
163.   - "8060:8060"
164. ```
165. 
166. ### Use a Different Ignition Version
167. Edit `docker-compose.local.yml` and change the `image:` tag:
168. ```yaml
169. image: inductiveautomation/ignition:8.3.9  # or any other version
170. ```
171. 
172. ### Timezone
173. Set the `TZ` environment variable:
174. ```bash
175. TZ=America/Chicago docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
176. ```
177. 
178. ---
179. 
180. ## Troubleshooting
181. 
182. ### Container won't start
183. ```bash
184. # Check logs
185. docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs ignition
186. 
187. # Verify Docker is running
188. docker ps
189. 
190. # Ensure port 8088/8043/8060 are not already in use
191. lsof -i :8088
192. ```
193. 
194. ### Changes not reflecting in gateway
195. - **View/page changes**: Refresh the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R for hard refresh)
196. - **Script changes**: Restart the ignition container (`docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml restart ignition`)
197. - **Style classes**: Clear browser cache and restart Ignition
198. 
199. ### Cannot connect to gateway
200. 1. Check container is running: `docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml ps`
201. 2. Check logs: `docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs ignition`
202. 3. Wait a full minute—initialization can take 30-60 seconds
203. 4. Try restarting: `docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml restart ignition`
204. 
205. ### "Address already in use" error
206. Port 8088, 8043, or 8060 is already bound. Either:
207. - Stop the process using the port: `lsof -i :8088`
208. - Edit `docker-compose.local.yml` to use different host ports
209. 
210. ---
211. 
212. ## Project Conventions
213. 
214. ### Perspective Views
215. - All views use **NxEdge style classes** (defined in `NxSigma_Core/com.inductiveautomation.perspective/style-classes/nxedge/`)
216. - Use **Roboto** font exclusively
217. - Follow the **9-section design system** in `.github/DESIGN.md`
218. 
219. ### Gateway Scripts (Jython 2.7)
220. - Keep scripts Jython 2.7 compatible
221. - Use **step-by-step comments** for clarity
222. - Prefer **Named Queries** over inline SQL
223. - Log at INFO level for important events, DEBUG for polls/loops
224. 
225. ### Named Queries
226. - Store in project-specific `ignition/named-query/` folders
227. - Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
228. - Document query purpose in the `resource.json` comment field
229. 
230. ### Commits
231. Only commit **source files**:
232. - ✅ View JSON, Python scripts, named queries, style classes
233. - ❌ Runtime caches, compiled assets, test data, gateway state files
234. 
235. ---
236. 
237. ## Integration with CI/CD
238. 
239. The project root contains:
240. - `.githooks/` — Git hooks for local validation
241. - `.github/instructions/` — Coding standards and patterns
242. - `.github/skills/` — Specialized workflows (Perspective views, Jython, etc.)
243. 
244. Before pushing, ensure:
245. 1. View JSON is valid: `jq '.' path/to/view.json`
246. 2. Python syntax is valid: `python -m py_compile script.py`
247. 3. Scripts follow Ignition patterns (see `.github/instructions/`)
248. 
249. ---
250. 
251. ## Getting Help
252. 
253. - **Ignition Docs**: https://docs.inductiveautomation.com/
254. - **NxEdge Design System**: See `.github/DESIGN.md`
255. - **Project Conventions**: See `.github/instructions/`
256. - **Perspective Skills**: See `.github/skills/perspective-*/`
257. 
258. ---
259. 
260. ## Advanced: Running Tests
261.

 # Local Ignition 8.3 Development Setup
 
 This guide covers setting up a reproducible Ignition development environment on any system.
 
 ## Prerequisites
 
 - **Docker** and **Docker Compose** installed
 - **Git** (to clone the repository)
 - **Python 3.8+** (for optional local scripts)
 - **Disk space**: ~5 GB for Ignition data directory
 
 ## Quickstart (5 minutes)
 
 ### 1. Clone the Repository
 ```bash
 git clone https://github.com/NXEdge/SHD-Ignition-BOI1.git
 cd SHD-Ignition-BOI1
 ```
 
 ### 2. Start the Ignition Container
 ```bash
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
 ```
 
 The container will:
 - Initialize the Ignition 8.3.8 data directory (first run only)
 - Mount all project folders from this repo into the gateway
 - Start on `http://localhost:8088` (HTTP) and `https://localhost:8043` (HTTPS)
 
 ### 3. Verify It's Running
 ```bash
 # Wait for the gateway to initialize (~30-60 seconds)
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f ignition
 
 # Once you see "Ignition gateway running...", press Ctrl+C
 ```
 
 ### 4. Access the Gateway
 - **Gateway Admin Console**: `https://localhost:8043/admin` (ignore self-signed cert warning)
 - **Perspective**: `https://localhost:8043/web/NxSigma_Testbed/` (recommended for UI testing)
 - **Default credentials**: `admin` / `localdev123!`
 
 ---
 
 ## File Organization
 
 ### Docker & Environment
 
 | File | Purpose | Tracked? |
 |------|---------|----------|
 | `docker-compose.local.yml` | Container orchestration (Ignition 8.3.8) | ✅ Yes |
 | `.config/ignition/gateway.env` | Local API tokens and URLs for scripting | ✅ Yes |
 | `.ignition-local/` | Runtime Ignition data (generated) | ❌ No |
 | `.env` | System-specific overrides (if needed) | ❌ No |
 
 ### Ignition Projects
 
 All projects are mounted as live volumes into the container. Changes to JSON/Python files **auto-reload** in the gateway (for most resources).
 
 ```
 NxSigma_Core/                  Parent project (shared resources)
 ├── com.inductiveautomation.perspective/
 │   ├── style-classes/         NxEdge design tokens
 │   ├── stylesheet/            Global CSS
 │   ├── views/                 Embedded utility views
 │   └── page-config/           Shared page routing
 └── ignition/
     ├── script-python/         Shared gateway scripts
     ├── named-query/           SQL templates
     └── global-props/          Shared project properties
 
 NxSigma_Engine/                Logic layer (timers, startup scripts)
 NxSigma_LineMaster/            Perspective UI & page configs
 NxSigma_MaterialsManager/       Materials domain logic
 NxSigma_Testbed/               Development & testing
 ```
 
 ---
 
 ## Common Tasks
 
 ### Start/Stop the Gateway
 ```bash
 # Start
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
 
 # Stop
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml down
 
 # View logs
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f ignition
 
 # Restart (useful after major code changes)
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml restart ignition
 ```
 
 ### Access the Designer
 
 1. Download **Ignition Designer 8.3.8** from [inductiveautomation.com](https://www.inductiveautomation.com/downloads)
 2. Launch the Designer
 3. **File** → **Connect** → Enter:
    - **Gateway host**: `localhost:8088`
    - **Username**: `admin`
    - **Password**: `localdev123!`
 
 ### View Gateway Logs
 ```bash
 # Real-time logs
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f ignition
 
 # Last 100 lines
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs --tail 100 ignition
 ```
 
 ### Reset to Fresh State
 ```bash
 # Stop the container
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml down
 
 # Remove the cached data directory
 rm -rf .ignition-local/data
 
 # Start fresh
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
 ```
 
 ### Test Local API Integration
 
 The gateway exposes a local API for scripting:
 
 ```bash
 # Load credentials
 source .config/ignition/gateway.env
 
 # Test API connectivity
 curl -k -sS -H "Accept: application/json" \
   -H "X-Ignition-API-Token: ${X-Ignition-API-Token}" \
   https://localhost:8043/data/api/v1/ping
 
 # Scan project changes (after editing views/scripts)
 curl -k -sS -X POST \
   -H "Accept: application/json" \
   -H "X-Ignition-API-Token: ${X-Ignition-API-Token}" \
   https://localhost:8043/data/api/v1/scan/projects
 ```
 
 ---
 
 ## Customization
 
 ### Change Admin Password
 Edit `docker-compose.local.yml` and modify the `GATEWAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD` environment variable, then restart:
 ```bash
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml restart ignition
 ```
 
 ### Change Port Mappings
 Edit `docker-compose.local.yml` and update the `ports:` section:
 ```yaml
 ports:
   - "8088:8088"   # Change first number to expose on a different host port
   - "8043:8043"
   - "8060:8060"
 ```
 
 ### Use a Different Ignition Version
 Edit `docker-compose.local.yml` and change the `image:` tag:
 ```yaml
 image: inductiveautomation/ignition:8.3.9  # or any other version
 ```
 
 ### Timezone
 Set the `TZ` environment variable:
 ```bash
 TZ=America/Chicago docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d
 ```
 
 ---
 
 ## Troubleshooting
 
 ### Container won't start
 ```bash
 # Check logs
 docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs ignition
 
 # Verify Docker is running
 docker ps
 
 # Ensure port 8088/8043/8060 are not already in use
 lsof -i :8088
 ```
 
 ### Changes not reflecting in gateway
 - **View/page changes**: Refresh the browser (Ctrl+Shift+R for hard refresh)
 - **Script changes**: Restart the ignition container (`docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml restart ignition`)
 - **Style classes**: Clear browser cache and restart Ignition
 
 ### Cannot connect to gateway
 1. Check container is running: `docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml ps`
 2. Check logs: `docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs ignition`
 3. Wait a full minute—initialization can take 30-60 seconds
 4. Try restarting: `docker-compose -f docker-compose.local.yml restart ignition`
 
 ### "Address already in use" error
 Port 8088, 8043, or 8060 is already bound. Either:
 - Stop the process using the port: `lsof -i :8088`
 - Edit `docker-compose.local.yml` to use different host ports
 
 ---
 
 ## Project Conventions
 
 ### Perspective Views
 - All views use **NxEdge style classes** (defined in `NxSigma_Core/com.inductiveautomation.perspective/style-classes/nxedge/`)
 - Use **Roboto** font exclusively
 - Follow the **9-section design system** in `.github/DESIGN.md`
 
 ### Gateway Scripts (Jython 2.7)
 - Keep scripts Jython 2.7 compatible
 - Use **step-by-step comments** for clarity
 - Prefer **Named Queries** over inline SQL
 - Log at INFO level for important events, DEBUG for polls/loops
 
 ### Named Queries
 - Store in project-specific `ignition/named-query/` folders
 - Use parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection
 - Document query purpose in the `resource.json` comment field
 
 ### Commits
 Only commit **source files**:
 - ✅ View JSON, Python scripts, named queries, style classes
 - ❌ Runtime caches, compiled assets, test data, gateway state files
 
 ---
 
 ## Integration with CI/CD
 
 The project root contains:
 - `.githooks/` — Git hooks for local validation
 - `.github/instructions/` — Coding standards and patterns
 - `.github/skills/` — Specialized workflows (Perspective views, Jython, etc.)
 
 Before pushing, ensure:
 1. View JSON is valid: `jq '.' path/to/view.json`
 2. Python syntax is valid: `python -m py_compile script.py`
 3. Scripts follow Ignition patterns (see `.github/instructions/`)
 
 ---
 
 ## Getting Help
 
 - **Ignition Docs**: https://docs.inductiveautomation.com/
 - **NxEdge Design System**: See `.github/DESIGN.md`
 - **Project Conventions**: See `.github/instructions/`
 - **Perspective Skills**: See `.github/skills/perspective-*/`
 
 ---
 
 ## Advanced: Running Tests
 
 The repo includes test snippets and fixtures in `.designer-snippets/` and `.github/skills/`.
 
 To run a test script in the Designer Console:
 1. Open Designer → Connect to local gateway
 2. **Tools** → **Script Console**
 3. Paste code from a designer snippet
 4. Execute and verify output
 
 ---
 
 ## Advanced: Exporting & Importing Projects
 
 ### Export a project from the gateway
 ```bash
 # Use the Ignition API (see `.config/ignition/gateway.env` for tokens)
 curl -k -X GET \
   -H "X-Ignition-API-Token: ${X-Ignition-API-Token}" \
   https://localhost:8043/data/api/v1/projects/NxSigma_Testbed/export \
   > NxSigma_Testbed.proj
 ```
 
 ### Import a project into another gateway
 ```bash
 # Replace {TARGET_GATEWAY} with the target gateway URL/token
 curl -k -X POST \
   -F "file=@NxSigma_Testbed.proj" \
   -H "X-Ignition-API-Token: ${TARGET_TOKEN}" \
   https://{TARGET_GATEWAY}:8043/data/api/v1/projects/import
 ```
 
 ---
 
 ## Next Steps
 
 1. **Verify setup**: Visit `https://localhost:8043/admin` and check all projects are loaded
 2. **Review architecture**: Check `.github/copilot-instructions.md` for project structure
 3. **Start developing**: Edit a view in `NxSigma_Testbed/com.inductiveautomation.perspective/views/`, save, and refresh browser
 4. **Commit early**: `git add` your changes and commit regularly
 
 Happy building! 🚀
